freeze_model_modules: freeze model modules matching glob patterns like encoder.* and cls_head in a PyTorch nn.Module
freeze_modules_recursive: freeze modules and all their children recursively by name patterns in a PyTorch model
freeze_modules_non_recursive: freeze only the exact matched modules without affecting their children in a PyTorch model
validate_freeze_patterns: validate that all freeze glob patterns match at least one module name in a PyTorch model
lock_module_train_mode: lock a module's train method to prevent it from switching back to training mode
